spec.what: Forty-six Advanced Temporary Fencing papers from the event week, signed and photographed (Andrew, 23 Oct 2026, the photographs sent without words after 'I have fencing dockets more to send you'): twenty-seven hire agreements 36623-36640 and 36642-36650 installed 19-22 Oct 2026, ten Environmental Services service notes 24482-24491 (19-22 Oct) and nine collection forms 28569-28572, 28574-28575 and 28577-28579 (21-22 Oct); recorded through the page's own forms (recordHireAgreement, recordServiceNote, recordCollection) and the hire agreements charged at the 2026 card. Every figure read twice at full size, the hard ones from crops, and by independent readers. CCB event or demarcation from the programme request where there is one, or the paper's own words; the wheels are recorded as components because no paper carries a gate line and vehicle gates are inside the card's metre; mesh fence is recorded clean where the paper writes no scrim, and clean plus scrim on the same metres where it writes braced and scrimmed (the 2 Oct convention); bracing-only papers are components only; the hoarding on 36623 has no card line and is held as panels only; scrim on existing fences listed on the scrim-labour service notes is not charged from them - Advanced's sheet decides, and the page's reviewed scrim path is Andrew's word.

ops.location: S15 C2 - hoarding fence and demarcation
ops.note: Mesh fence 97.5 m (39 panels), hoarding 102.5 m (41 hoarding panels), CC barrier 100 m (40 barriers), 4 wheels, 149 bases, 148 clamps, 37 braces, installed 19 Oct 2026 at S15 C2; the site address reads 'S15, C.2 - / Hoarding Fence + Demarcation'. The CCB is Demarcation in the paper's own words (programme EVENT WEEK row 10, 19 Oct: Demarcation CCB - Admiralty Dr to S13 Grandstand, 99 m Demarcation). Programme rows 6-7 (19 Oct): Exclusion Zone - S15 Grandstand 90 m clean with a vehicle gate, Perimeter Fence - S15 Grandstand 100 m hoarding with a vehicle gate: the 4 wheels are the two vehicle gates, recorded as components (gates are inside the card's metre). THE HOARDING IS NOT CHARGED HERE: the 2026 card on this page has no hoarding line, so the 102.5 m is held on the paper and as 41 hoarding panels only - a rate is needed before the V8s are charged for it. Braces on the paper but no bracing metres and no scrim written, so clean is recorded - Advanced's sheet decides. Owner/site supervisor signature present, name not written; contact Brendan. Prices and totals blank on the paper.
